attempts.raw_response: He scored his first try at the tournament during the pool stage, demonstrating the attacking ability that had marked his junior career. His performances in Argentina helped raise his profile within South African rugby circles, and upon returning home, he began to attract attention from larger domestic franchises. Coaches praised his work rate and positional awareness, noting that he rarely seemed overawed on the international stage despite his youth. The tournament experience, even though it ended in disappointment with the semi-final loss, proved invaluable to his development. Later that year, he transitioned into senior provincial rugby, where he would soon establish himself as a regular starter and begin building the reputation that would define his professional career in the years ahead.

pair.prefix: In 2010, he was selected for the South Africa Under-20 side that played at the 2010 IRB Junior World Championship in Argentina. He was an unused reserve in their first match against Tonga, but started in their 73–0 victory over Scotland. He played off the bench in their remaining three matches – the final pool stage match against Australia, their 36–7 semi-final defeat to eventual winners New Zealand and their third-place play-off match against England.
